coordinate_system.origin: optical centre of the left camera
coordinate_system.z_axis: forward, along the left camera optical axis (depth)

experimental_depth_fit.fit_method: Unweighted least squares: disparity_px = numerator_m_px / known_forward_depth_m + disparity_offset_px

note: EXPERIMENTAL, NOT VALIDATED. Requires updated StereoRig code supporting experimental_depth_fit; older executables silently ignore the fit. Original intrinsics and rectification preserved. Coefficients apply only to this 1280x720 processing space and unchanged rig/capture settings. This is an empirical depth correction, NOT a recovered physical calibration; does not correct vertical misalignment, lens distortion, or bad correspondences. X/Y and velocity remain unvalidated. Fit includes the anomalous 2 m point with 71 px vertical difference. Held-out prediction error reaches about 1.9 m at 8 m. Validate on independent physical measurements; extrapolation beyond 2-8 m is unreliable. Disparities <=92.7692307692308 px are rejected. Set max disparity >=700 px for the supplied 2 m reference (682.6 px); the 512 px default excludes it. No executable rebuilt.
